description: Send a workspace invitation. Fillo emails the address, and accepting gives that person access to every form, response, and setting in the workspace at the role you pick. That is mail leaving Fillo to a person, and access changing — ASK THE HUMAN FIRST with the exact address and role, then pass confirm=true. You can never grant a role above the acting person's own. Needs members:manage.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the human has approved this action. Ask them first and quote what it will do — never set this on your own initiative.

name: fillo_invite_member
title: Invite someone to the workspace
